name: Rictavio
title: Showman and Bard
summary: A loud half-elf showman in loud clothes, lodging at the Blue Water Inn with a carnival wagon he lets no one near. The tunes are cheerful; the eyes are a hunter's.

guest_build.note: Rictavio's own stat block (Rudolph van Richten in disguise); joins only if the Tarokka names him.
